answer: Sybil resistance here rests on stake bonded per identity plus a reputation path that pays only after independent work is verified. An attacker wanting many wallets must post collateral on every one, and that collateral is slashable whenever a cluster is caught voting in lockstep. This is the forge the design leans on: faking one identity is cheap, but each extra head must be funded and held at risk across the whole epoch window. Coordinated slashing is the nadir for a farmer, since a shared cost converts a cloned marble of stake into a real balance loss.
